name: TDK-c
title: C series general-purpose multilayer ceramic chip capacitors, C0402 to C5750, up to 50 V

source.document: MULTILAYER CERAMIC CHIP CAPACITORS, C series, general (up to 50 V), Chinese edition

summary: TDK's C series covers general-purpose multilayer ceramic chip capacitors in nine body sizes, from C0402 (EIA 01005, 0.4 × 0.2 mm) to C5750 (EIA 2220, 5.7 × 5.0 mm), rated 4 V to 50 V DC. Two class 1 (temperature compensating) characteristics, C0G and CH, run from 0.5 pF upward; five class 2 (high dielectric constant) characteristics, JB, X5R, X6S, X7R and X7S, reach 100 µF. Each catalog number fixes size, characteristic, voltage, capacitance, tolerance, nominal thickness and reel. The parts are lead free and RoHS compliant.

operation.text: Thinner ceramic dielectric layers stacked in more layers give high capacitance. The monolithic body is mechanically strong and reliable. Frequency characteristics are good and come close to the theoretical design values, and the low ESR keeps self-heating under ripple current small.
General electronic equipment, mobile communication equipment, power supply circuits, office automation, TVs and LED displays, servers, PCs, notebooks and tablets.

Class 1 parts (C0G, CH) run from 0.5 pF in C0402 to C1608 up to 220 nF in C4532; C5750 has no class 1 parts. Class 2 parts start at 100 pF in C0402 and reach 100 µF, which comes in JB, X5R and X6S at 4 V to 10 V in C3216 and larger. 50 V class 2 parts appear from C1005 upward.
From January 2013 the catalog number drops the parentheses around its last five characters. Catalog numbers are used for orders from the catalog, not for OEM orders.
